request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Add only one thing: a third leg. The machine now stands on two legs, left and right; add one more leg exactly in the middle between them, going straight down from the centre of the body to the ground, in the same style: dark gunmetal with a round chrome knee and a chunky chrome foot. Exactly three legs in total, with empty gaps between them. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hood, eye lens, arm, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
